resources.string: Your SMS stays on your phone unless it matches the configured bank sender. Raw SMS messages are not stored by this companion, and no transaction is added to Expendicure until you confirm it in the web app.
Expendicure reads incoming SMS only to detect transaction notifications from the bank sender you configure. It ignores every other message on the device.
Saved server address (used for real SMS)
You have unsaved changes. Incoming bank SMS is forwarded using the SAVED settings only — tap Test Connection or Save Configuration to apply them.
Saved server address did not respond. Check the IP and port, and that this phone is on the same Wi-Fi as your PC.
Bank sender ID (e.g. HDFCBK) — NOT your phone number
Connected. This sender is configured on your Expendicure account.
Ingest token was rejected. Re-copy it from Connections → Manage.
Could not reach that URL. On a phone, use your PC\'s LAN IP, not localhost.
Reached Expendicure, but that sender is not a configured, enabled bank on your account.
Expendicure returned a server error. Try again shortly.
Expendicure rejected the request. Check the server URL.
Off — transaction details are extracted on this phone. If a message can\'t be read here it is discarded and nothing is sent.
On — if a message can\'t be read on this phone, the raw SMS text is sent to your own Expendicure server on the local network so it can try. In this mode the raw SMS does leave the phone.
SMS seen: %1$d · sender matched: %2$d · parsed on device: %3$d · new events: %4$d
Enter an https URL, or an http URL on your local network (10.x / 192.168.x / *.local).
Enter the bank\'s SMS sender ID (max 40 characters). This is not your mobile number.
Paste the ingest token from Expendicure → Connections.
